game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden, a garden growing near vents: the fire warden must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Unit Trader: Convert units using expressions so each trade of fire gems is fair.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden: a garden growing near vents
core_gameplay_loop: In Vent Garden, repeat each round: Convert units using expressions so each trade of fire gems is fair. Each round, a new fire gems challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the fair_trades value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 290 points of fire gems by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 290, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 4 (applied tier): Unit Trader
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Unit Trader' (Week 2 slot 14), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Vent Garden'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how fair_trades changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Vent Garden.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 290 within 31 seconds.
